test_title: PYST 40: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

÷ and ×, 1 and 3

I. 6 + 4 - 9 × 3 ÷ 1

II. 4 × 3 - 1 + 8 ÷ 2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging of numbers and mathematical signs:

 
• ÷ and ×
 
• 1 and 3

**So, Given equations : ​​**

I. 6 + 4 - 9 × 3 ÷ 1 ⇒ 6 + 4 - __**9 ÷ 1**__ × 3

⇒ 6 + 4 - __**9 × 3**__

⇒ __**6 + 4**__ - 27

⇒ __**10 - 27**__

⇒ **-17**

II. 4 × 3 - 1 + 8 ÷ 2 ⇒ __**4 ÷ 1**__ - 3 + 8 × 2

⇒ 4 - 3 + __**8 × 2**__

⇒ __**4 + 16**__ - 3

⇒ __**20 - 3**__

⇒ **17**

Thus, according to the question **values for equation I and II are (-17) and 17 respectively.**

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
